status: post-hoc exploratory development; not independent validation
motivation: Test learned region-conditioned summaries against matched shuffled and generic contexts; the previous mean-pooling gate failed on selected sequences.
training: Reuse the 12 verified native-read samples, 24-step schedule, seed, optimizer and loss from the completed CFBI pilot. Frozen SAM2; independently train regional, shuffled and generic adapters with identical sample schedule.
validation: Full autonomous propagation, first ground-truth mask prompt, own predicted memory; compare per-sequence present Dice, boundary F, empty-frame false alarms and return-frame overlap against archived native and controls.
gates: Require full seq2 zero-gate prediction parity, nonzero seq3 regional/shuffled/generic propagation, frozen-source tests, source and input integrity checks before launch. Stop on error.
interpretation: These selected sequences and all of PolypGen informed earlier work; this is not an independent or patient-independent test. Do not choose a seed or configuration after viewing these outcomes without disclosing selection.
